summary: Prenetics Global Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, announcing a multi-year partnership with Inter Miami CF. Under the agreement, Prenetics' IM8 brand becomes the exclusive official health supplements partner of Inter Miami CF, with branding at the training center and stadium, product distribution to players, and NIL rights for at least four players. The partnership includes an equity stake in Prenetics by Inter Miami, a first for the club. No financial terms, premium, or deal structure are disclosed. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report, not a special situation under the defined categories.
